claim: In the matching retail DLL, the four small RefereeMan construction/population methods are exact and branchless. RefereeMan..ctor (0x060050B1) has an exact 19-byte body that allocates a one-element Referee array, stores it in field RefereeObj (0x040062DE), then calls UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour..ctor. RefereeMan.Awake (0x060050B3) has an exact 7-byte body that stores this into static field RefereeMan.inst (0x040062DC). RefereeMan.Start (0x060050B4) is an exact one-byte ret. RefereeMan.CreateReferee (0x060050B5) has an exact 39-byte body: local index is raw 0; it calls UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(Prefab_Referee), stores the result, writes result.GetComponent<Referee>() into RefereeObj[0], reloads RefereeObj[0], and returns it. FACT-0065 already closes the GetInst/GetRefereeObj readers of these same fields.
